messages.content: Let me check the scheduling history.

function.name: get_schedule_history
function.description: Returns a chronological list of every scheduling-related event for a job: original booking, reschedules, reassignments, cancellations, tech-on-way, tech-arrived, completed. Use when the CSC asks 'why was this rescheduled' or 'how many times has this been pushed back'. Events come back in chronological order with timestamps and metadata.
